container_group_name.title: Container Group Name
container_group_name.description: Required* Must be 2-63 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens. Cannot start with a number or start/end with a hyphen.

container_environment_unsloth_password.title: Studio Admin Password
container_environment_unsloth_password.description: Required* Password to log into the Unsloth Studio web UI. Choose a strong one - the UI can run code on the machine.

container_environment_hf_token.title: HuggingFace Token (optional)
container_environment_hf_token.description: Optional. Lets Studio pull gated models and push your trained LoRA/models to the Hub so they survive node reallocation. Must begin with "hf_" or "api_org_". Leave empty to skip.
